artworks.title: Plate Number 720. Cat; galloping
artworks.artist: Eadweard Muybridge
artworks.description: This is a series of twenty-four black-and-white photographs capturing a cat in motion. The photos are organized into a grid pattern with four rows, each showing a different phase of the cat's stride as its limbs extend and contract. The cat's fur is spotted, and its head faces the right in all the photographs. The background of the photographs appears to be a thin grid, and each has a small number in the bottom left corner. Between the rows of photos are black borders.

artworks.title: Bust of an Italian Woman
artworks.artist: Giuseppe de Nittis
artworks.creditLine: Purchased for the Virginia and Ira  Jackson Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman. She is in a profile pose, with her face turned slightly to the left. Her hair is styled up, and she wears a loose garment around her shoulders. There are no visible objects or jewelry, and the background is plain.

artworks.title: Bertoldo Riding a Donkey
artworks.artist: Giuseppe Maria Crespi and Ludovico Mattioli
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting atop a donkey, with a natural setting in the background. The individual appears serene, wearing simple clothes and a large hat. The background includes a tree, clouds, and a distant building.

artworks.title: Bertoldo with a Sieve on His Head
artworks.artist: Giuseppe Maria Crespi and Ludovico Mattioli
artworks.description: The image contains straight lines and curved forms with a figure in the foreground. The figure has a circular object with small holes in place of a head, resembling a colander or sieve, and holds a similar disc in its hands. In the background, there are flowing lines suggestive of hills and sharp, angular lines of trees with windswept branches.

artworks.title: Bertoldo Holding a Hare
artworks.artist: Giuseppe Maria Crespi and Ludovico Mattioli
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing upright. He is facing slightly to the right with one hand resting against his chin while the other cradles an object. The man has a mustache, beard, long hair under a wide-brimmed hat, and is wearing a coat with a belt, knee-length britches, stockings, and shoes. A barren tree bends dramatically to his left. In the background, rolling hills and clouds are visible.

artworks.title: Bertoldo Stuffed in a Sack
artworks.artist: Giuseppe Maria Crespi and Ludovico Mattioli
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals. The person on the left is covered in a large cloak, only their head visible and slightly tilted downward. They wear a wide-brimmed hat. The other person stands upright facing the first person. They have short hair, wear a cap, tunic, tight pants, and boots. The second individual gestures towards the first. Both lack visible jewelry or objects. The background shows a textured wall with parallel lines and hatching. Italian text below the scene provides context.

artworks.title: Bertoldo Placing the Jailer in the Sack
artworks.artist: Giuseppe Maria Crespi and Ludovico Mattioli
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing sideways, holding a large sack that obscures their face. The person's hands are raised around the top of the sack, potentially tying it closed. The person is wearing loose-fitting clothing, possibly a coat or tunic, and boots or shoes. The background has a textured wall and a plain floor. No jewelry or extra objects are visible.

artworks.title: Bertoldo Hiding in a Furnace
artworks.artist: Giuseppe Maria Crespi and Ludovico Mattioli
artworks.description: The image depicts a person seated inside a small arched opening of a brick structure. The person is in a sitting position, with arms wrapped around their legs. The person wears a textured outfit covering their body, including their legs and feet. The background shows a landscape with trees and hills. The illustration is bordered by Italian script attributing the work to Giuseppe Crespi.

artworks.title: Bertoldino Lying on a Donkey
artworks.artist: Giuseppe Maria Crespi and Ludovico Mattioli
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a donkey standing beside a tree with a figure draped over its back. The scene depicts a rural landscape with a single tree to the left, and the donkey standing on a rocky terrain under a sky with stylized clouds. The figure is lying across the donkey's back. The illustration employs a monochrome palette, executed with fine lines and shading to convey texture and depth. Below the image, there is some text in Italian.

artworks.title: Bertoldino Enraged by the Croaking Frogs
artworks.artist: Giuseppe Maria Crespi and Ludovico Mattioli
artworks.description: The image shows a figure standing by a stone well. The person is depicted lifting the lid of a wooden chest placed on the well. The background includes a cloudy sky with lined shading. Italian text is inscribed below the main image.

artworks.title: Marcolfa Sees Bertoldino Hatching Eggs
artworks.artist: Giuseppe Maria Crespi and Ludovico Mattioli
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals in a scene. A child is seated on the ground wearing a long-sleeved outfit, holding an object close to their mouth. Ducks are in the foreground, pecking the ground. Behind the child, a man in a long robe and cap looks out from behind a brick wall. Another head with curly hair appears from a makeshift structure. In the background is a textured wall with a partly cloudy sky beyond.

artworks.title: Bertoldino Fastening Geese to His Belt
artworks.artist: Giuseppe Maria Crespi and Ludovico Mattioli
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals. The child in the foreground is standing with one foot raised, looking down at their hands holding an object. They are wearing minimal clothing with a piece of fabric wrapped around them. The adult in the background, possibly a woman, is partially visible standing near an open door. They are holding an object and wearing a long dress and a hat. In the background, there is a tree, an open space, birds near the ground, and a woven basket.

artworks.title: Bertoldino Falling into a Fish Pond
artworks.artist: Giuseppe Maria Crespi and Ludovico Mattioli
artworks.description: This is an image of a person falling alongside birds in flight. The scene includes a person falling and a flock of birds flying in the air with another figure standing at the edge of a structure. The drawing features architectural elements and a caption below the image.

artworks.title: Bertoldino Whipping Himself to Kill Flies
artworks.artist: Giuseppe Maria Crespi and Ludovico Mattioli
artworks.description: The image shows a cherubic child figure standing with one arm raised and the other holding a small broom-like object. The child is positioned with one foot lifted as if beginning to take a step. The face is plump with round cheeks, and short, curly hair. The child appears to be unclothed. Surrounding the child, in the background, there is a brick wall with a garment draped over it, and a few flying insects dot the air. There is also a tree with broad leaves growing nearby, and hilly terrain can be seen in the distance. The sky is depicted with soft lines indicating clouds.

artworks.title: Bertoldino with the Birds Carried Away By the Kite
artworks.artist: Giuseppe Maria Crespi and Ludovico Mattioli
artworks.description: The image shows a child standing and partially running with its right foot forward. The child is looking up towards the sky with a slightly open mouth. The child has short wavy hair and is wearing loose, flowing historical clothing. The child's left hand is reaching up and the right arm is bent at the elbow, pointing upwards. The child is outside near a building with an open door, next to a landscape with a small hill or mountain and a few trees. Above the child, a rooster is depicted on a rope or branch. The scene has a rustic and historical feel with intricate cross-hatching defining the textures and shadows.

artworks.title: Bertoldino Cutting Off the Donkey's Ears
artworks.artist: Giuseppe Maria Crespi and Ludovico Mattioli
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright with one hand raised, holding a sharp object. They have a large head with short, dark hair, and wear a long coat, buttoned at the top, with a knee-length hem. The person is barefoot. In the background, there is another figure raising their hands, and a donkey with its head lowered. The setting appears outdoors, with a tree swaying in the wind. The ground is rough and sparse. There is an inscription below the image.

artworks.title: Menghina with a Basket of Herbs
artworks.artist: Giuseppe Maria Crespi and Ludovico Mattioli
artworks.description: The image depicts two full-length figures standing on a grassy landscape. The woman stands slightly turned to her side, with her head tilted and looking back towards the viewer. She wears a long dress and holds a basket. The child stands beside her, holding the woman's dress. Both figures are barefoot and the scene is set against bushes and clouds in the sky.

artworks.title: Menghina Quiets Cacasenno with a Chestnut Cake
artworks.artist: Giuseppe Maria Crespi and Ludovico Mattioli
artworks.description: The image shows two figures - an adult standing and a child at knee level. The adult has a serene facial expression with soft features and tied-up hair. They are wearing a long robe with loose sleeves. The child is looking up at the adult, holding onto their knees. The child is in a long garment with a cap, barefoot. The background shows an outdoor space with rocks, plants, shrubs, and a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Marcolfa Showing Cacasenno a Horse
artworks.artist: Giuseppe Maria Crespi and Ludovico Mattioli
artworks.description: The image depicts a person and a child interacting with a horse. The person is positioned to the right, bending forward while holding a rope connected to the horse. The child is reaching out with one arm raised. The person has distinct facial features with strong eyebrows and is wearing a wide-brimmed hat. They are dressed in a robe or long garment, while the child, with short hair, is wearing a short tunic or dress. The background shows a lightly sketched landscape with a cloudy sky and simple earthy ground. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or extra objects in the scene.

artworks.title: Cacasenno on Horseback
artworks.artist: Giuseppe Maria Crespi and Ludovico Mattioli
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a person riding a horse. The drawing shows a rider on a horse, with the rider appearing to struggle with maintaining balance. The lines of the horse's mane and body are detailed, creating a sense of motion. The background is simple, showing some foliage or landscape in the distance. There is Italian text underneath the drawing.

artworks.title: Cacasenno Riding a Horse Backwards
artworks.artist: Giuseppe Maria Crespi and Ludovico Mattioli
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting sideways on a horse. The person is seated as though riding the horse backward, with their face and body turned to look over the horse's rump. The person has a masculine appearance with a smooth face, a distinctive nose, and short, dark hair partially covered by a headscarf. They wear a loose-fitting garment with long sleeves and a sash at the waist, and their feet are placed in stirrups. One hand rests on the horse's back. The horse is mid-stride, with texture in its mane and tail, giving a sense of motion. In the background, there are trees and a hilly landscape beneath a sky with stylized clouds. The scene is rendered in an etching style, and there is an inscription at the bottom in Italian.

artworks.title: Cacasenno Eating Pasta
artworks.artist: Giuseppe Maria Crespi and Ludovico Mattioli
artworks.description: The image displays a seated figure with their full body in view. The person is on the ground, leaning slightly forward, supporting a large bowl in front of them with one hand, while the other hand is raised towards their mouth. Their facial features are partially obscured by their bowed head. Their head is covered with a cloth or turban-like wrap, and they are wearing a loose-fitting outfit. The background shows a textured image of an old building or ruins, with mountainous or hilly scenery.

artworks.title: Saints Peter and Paul
artworks.artist: Gaetano Gandolfi, after Guido Reni
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 45.9 × 30.2 cm (18 1/16 × 11 7/8 in.)
sheet: 46.6 × 30.2 cm (18 3/8 × 11 7/8 in.) trimmed within platemark
mount: 47.5 × 32 cm (18 11/16 × 12 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two people. One is seated, leaning on their left arm with a hand supporting their head. They have short, curly hair, a beard, wear draped robes that expose one shoulder and legs, and there are keys on the ground by their feet. The other person is standing, facing the seated individual with a speaking gesture, thick, curly hair, a full beard, and draped clothing. They hold a book in the crook of their right arm. The background includes a stone structure, foliage, and a distant landscape with trees and buildings. The artwork is monochrome with detailed linework throughout.

artworks.title: Saints Peter and Paul
artworks.artist: Gaetano Gandolfi, after Guido Reni
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two men in a scene. One man is seated, resting his head on his hand and displaying large keys on the ground. The other man is standing, gesturing with his hand and holding a book. There is a background with trees, distant architecture, and a structure with columns.
